title: Low-temperature heat capacity and the thermodynamic functions of a novel ether-based ionic liquid 1-(2-ethoxyethyl)-3-ethylimidazolium thiocyanate
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34971-34978
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06593J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Donglu Fu, Zongren Song, Jiankang Liu, Jie Yang, Shilong Suo, Kunhao Liang, Xiaoxue Ma, Dawei Fang
A novel ionic liquid [C22O2Im][SCN] was prepared. The low temperature heat capacity of [C22O2Im][SCN] was determined, and the related thermodynamic functions, such as (HT − H298.15), (ST − S298.15) and (GT − G298.15), were calculated.
